title: 第二十九章入山
novel_title: 开局阴阳宗，从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
content_zh:
他瞅着不成样子的床榻，自然想起了系统之前的介绍。

    【修至圆满，可如熊般，获千斤之力，体魄坚韧。自身经脉经过千锤百炼，韧性自然远超同境之人。】

    千斤之力……他握了握手掌，然后一拳递出，划破空气，发出一声巨大的音爆。

    好霸道，他摸了摸愈发健硕的身体，顿感这件功法的玄妙。

    不过，这还不是这件功法最主要的作用。

    他迫不及待想试一试，不过他看着碎成几半的床榻，瞬间意识到一个问题。

    我好像没地方睡觉了。

    他摇摇头，瞅了眼地面，犹豫几秒，就地而坐。

    今天就在地板上凑合一下吧。

    他盘腿坐好，取出之前从江燕那里得来的金髓锻骨丹，含入口中。

    他依稀记得金髓锻骨丹之前记录的效果，可以加强经脉和肉身的强度。

    不过此刻倒也是正好，居然可以搭配这套功法一起使用。

    之前实在是来不及，一下子就疼晕了过去，来不及服药。

    现在好不容易有机会了，一定要把这枚丹药完全消化完。

    玄熊蛰息经开始发动，丹药也自动化开，融入他的身体。

    他只感觉自身经脉又开始发热，不过这次倒是没有之前那般暴力的痛感，只留下一道温暖的感觉游走。

    他闭上双眼，微微感受，同时将注意力全部聚集到呼吸上。

    一呼一吸，开始变慢，张守安试着学习之前那只熊妖，开始引导周围灵力的游走。

    他的心跳慢慢放松，整个人陷入了一种似睡非睡的状态，周遭的灵力开始向他汇集，融入他的气海之中。

    速度很快同时也很稳定。

    本来这套圆满的功法就能帮他吸收大量灵力，再加上他自身九阳归元体的影响，他现在就像一个在海里的漩涡，将四周所有的灵力都一扫而空。

    张守安有意无意地将气海中的灵力压缩，再压缩。

    就是为了在有限的气海中储存更多的灵气。

    最后他整个人的身体都开始微微泛出白光，展现出一种静谧。

    一夜，两天，已然过去，转眼间就到了熊妖大婚之日。

    刘全今天早早就起了床，来到了中央的那个营帐之外。
content_en:
He looked at the shabby bed and naturally remembered the previous introduction to the system.

[When you practice to perfection, you can be like a bear, gain the strength of a thousand catties, and have a tough body.His own meridians have been tempered for many times, and his resilience is naturally far superior to that of people in the same situation.】

The force of a thousand pounds... He shook his hand, then punched out, cutting through the air and making a huge sonic boom.

So domineering, he touched his increasingly muscular body and suddenly felt the mystery of this technique.

However, this is not the most important function of this technique.

He couldn't wait to give it a try, but when he looked at the broken bed, he instantly realized a problem.

I don't seem to have anywhere to sleep.

He shook his head, glanced at the ground, hesitated for a few seconds, and sat down on the spot.

Just make do on the floor today.

He sat cross-legged, took out the Golden Marrow Bone Forging Pill he had obtained from Jiang Yan before, and put it into his mouth.

He vaguely remembered the previously recorded effects of the Golden Marrow Bone Forging Pill, which could strengthen the meridians and the physical body.

But it's just right at this moment, and it can be used together with this set of exercises.

It was too late before. I fainted from the pain and had no time to take the medicine.

Now that I finally have the opportunity, I must completely digest this elixir.

The Black Bear's Breathing Sutra began to activate, and the elixir was automatically opened and integrated into his body.

He only felt that his meridians began to heat up again, but this time there was no violent pain like before, leaving only a warm feeling wandering away.

He closed his eyes, felt it slightly, and focused all his attention on his breathing.

Breathing in and out began to slow down. Zhang Shou'an tried to imitate the bear demon before and began to guide the surrounding spiritual energy.

His heartbeat slowly relaxed, and his whole body fell into a state of sleep, as the spiritual energy around him began to gather towards him and merge into his sea of ​​energy.

It's fast and stable at the same time.

Originally, this perfect set of techniques could help him absorb a large amount of spiritual energy. Coupled with the influence of his own Nine Yang Guiyuan Body, he is now like a whirlpool in the sea, sweeping away all the spiritual energy around him.

Zhang Shouan intentionally or unintentionally compressed and then compressed the spiritual power in the sea of ​​qi.

Just to store more spiritual energy in the limited air sea.

Finally, his entire body began to glow slightly with white light, showing a kind of tranquility.

One night, two days, had passed, and in the blink of an eye it was the wedding day of the bear demon.

Liu Quan got up early today and came outside the central tent.
